verdict.rationale: The official GitHub README claims pnpm is "up to 2x faster than the alternatives" and points to a benchmark section, so first-party published benchmarks exist. A community user also reports measured CI install times of 15s versus 35s. However, the pack does not contain the benchmark figures, methodology or scenarios themselves, so only the claim and its pointer are evidenced. Missing for 10: the actual benchmark numbers and methodology (e.g., cold/warm cache, lockfile scenarios), and independent reproducible benchmarks beyond a single anecdotal timing.
